run_diatomic_curve_test: run a diatomic potential energy curve test for a given MLIP model and task
compute_diatomic_curve: compute the diatomic potential energy curve for a pair of atoms using a predictor model
get_model: load a pretrained MLIP model for prediction using either released or custom model paths
generate_plot: generate a potential energy curve plot for a diatomic molecule and save it as an image
combined_plot: generate a combined plot of multiple diatomic potential energy curves in a single figure
